verdict.rationale: Thoropass is a SaaS compliance platform, so versioned APIs with a deprecation policy is a fair axis. The evidence pack documents an MCP server, integrations and an llms.txt, but nothing about API versioning or a deprecation policy. The MCP server is a different capability and cannot be credited here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
